delphiPalettes: Color Palettes Curated by 'delphi.tools'

Source: R/delphiPalettes-package.R
delphiPalettes-package.Rd

Provides color palettes from the collection at 'delphi.tools' https://delphi.tools. delphi creates privacy-respecting design tools https://github.com/1612elphi/delphitools. The package groups palettes by category. It returns palette colors or interpolated colors. It also reports whether a palette keeps distinct colors under simulated color vision differences.
